title: Thornwild
tagline: An original 2.5D cinematic platformer with nine worlds, five companions and six giant guardians.
stateNote: The README links to a hosted build that returned a 404 when I checked, so no demo is linked.
problem: A big-hearted platformer where you run, wall-climb, dash and ground pound through living jungles and glowing caves, and grow a home of your own.
audience: Platformer fans who like exploration and companions.
contribution: It is my project, with its own characters, worlds and music. The repository lives under the name 'donkeykong'.
worksToday: The README describes nine worlds, wall-climbing, dashing and ground pounds.
